tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (10.0:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.sidebar`, `.btn-secondary`, `.card`; text on `.btn-primary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-300
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.input::placeholder`. 1.9:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-400

tokens.name: color-gray-700
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.btn-secondary`, `.list-item-title`; background on `.btn-primary:hover`. 10.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-800
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.nav-link.active`; background on `.btn-primary`. 13.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success

tokens.name: color-error
